# Companion Sugar fixtures (M8)

**Synthetic.** Authored for M8 tests next to the sanitized discovery evidence
in `fixtures/sugarcrm/sanitized/` (kept verbatim). They reference the same
`FIX-` ids and add what the discovery set lacks (plan §28):

| File                         | Purpose                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `accounts.csv`               | `FIX-ACC-001`–`016` (no `FIX-ACC-DOES-NOT-EXIST`: orphans stay orphans)                                                     |
| `opportunities.csv`          | the discovery lines' opportunities, `FIX-OPP-019` (fallback account) and `FIX-OPP-020` (no account)                         |
| `product_templates.csv`      | every product the discovery lines reference (no `FIX-PROD-DOES-NOT-EXIST`), duplicate names, literal `NULL`, `FIX-PROD-900` |
| `users.csv`                  | one internal user (C5)                                                                                                      |
| `rli_companion.csv`          | Closed Lost and open-pipeline lines (C1), account-less lines with/without a usable opportunity                              |
| `rli_unmodelled_product.csv` | a line whose product is in the catalogue but not in the product model (C2)                                                  |
| `fields-v1.json`             | `/{Module}/fields` metadata in the assumed Sugar shape (LIVE); drift variants are derived in `test/support/fake-sugar.ts`   |

Pagination sets (1,000+ lines, C4) are generated by a seeded function, not
committed. Enum options are synthetic fixture values, not a customer
picklist.
